subject: MAP: POC Environment - Action Items & Timeline (VPC peering, SSO, IP allowlist)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Tom Calder <tom.calder@brightpath.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC Environment - Action Items & Timeline (VPC peering, SSO, IP allowlist)

Hi Tom / Elena — thanks again for the call earlier. Per our discussion, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the POC environment setup and the dependencies we scoped out. Below is a concise recap and the immediate next steps we recommend to keep the POC on track.

Quick recap (goals):
- 2-week POC to validate throughput and latency with a 10k monthly token workload
- Private test environment with restricted access (VPC peering + IP allowlist)
- SSO/SAML for developer/test access and KMS-backed secrets for keys

POC environment MAP — milestone summary (owner / target date):
1) Network & Access (VPC peering + NAT/IP allowlist) — Owner: BrightPath (Tom) — Target: 2026-05-18
   - Dependencies: cloud account info, allowed IP range, test subnet for peering
2) Identity & Access (SSO/SAML integration + test user group) — Owner: BrightPath (Elena) — Target: 2026-05-20
   - Dependencies: IdP metadata (SAML XML), test user identities, attribute mapping
3) Secrets & Keys (KMS integration, service principal) — Owner: Redwood (Marcus) — Target: 2026-05-14
   - Dependencies: KMS ARN, service account permissions, rotation policy
4) App-level testing & smoke tests — Owner: BrightPath + Redwood (joint) — Target: 2026-05-25
5) POC completion & sign-off — Owner: BrightPath (stakeholder) — Target close: 2026-06-04

Immediate asks (this week):
- Tom: please share the BrightPath cloud account ID and the CIDR(s) you expect to allow (for VPC peering / allowlist).
- Elena: can you export the IdP SAML metadata file and confirm one test user we can use (email + display name)?
- Marcus (cc): I’ve asked Marcus to provision a Redwood service principal and share the KMS ARN; Marcus, please confirm ETA.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP milestone table), brightpath_network_diagram.png, sso_requirements_brightpath.pdf.

I’ll follow up mid-week with an updated MAP once we have the cloud account + IdP metadata. If any of the dates above are aggressive, flag them and we’ll adjust — happy to run a short sync to re-prioritize.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: MAP: POC Environment - Action Items & Timeline (VPC peering, SSO, IP allowlist)

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. This looks actionable. Quick answers and owners below: 

- Cloud account & network: we will provide the AWS account ID and two CIDR ranges by EOD Wednesday (2026-05-06). I’ll own the VPC peering ticket with our infra team.
- SSO/SAML: Elena will send the IdP metadata file and a test user (elena.rossi@brightpath.ai) by Wednesday. We will also provide attribute mappings (email, firstName, lastName).
- KMS: we expect Redwood to manage the service principal; please validate the principal has decrypt/encrypt permissions for the test key.

Timeline note: Our infra team has a scheduled change freeze window 2026-05-15 to 2026-05-17 for unrelated ops work — we may need to shift the VPC peering target if peering requires network team's intervention during that window. Otherwise the dates look good.

I’ll attach the network diagram we use internally (see brightpath_network_diagram.png) — it highlights the subnet ranges we’ll allocate.

Thanks,
Tom Calder
Head of Platform, BrightPath Analytics

- Marcus confirmed KMS/service principal ETA and will share ARN by 2026-05-07.

Updated MAP highlights (targets):

Next steps (this week):
1) Tom: send AWS account ID + CIDR(s) (reply inline is fine).
2) Elena: attach the SAML metadata file and confirm test user.
3) Marcus: paste the KMS ARN in thread when ready.
4) Monica: I’ll send a calendar invite for the 2026-05-12 validation slot once Tom confirms the account details.

References: HubSpot Deal RDW-6342, MAP v1.1 attached.

If anyone needs to re-prioritize items we can run a 20-minute sync — otherwise I’ll publish MAP v1.1 to the shared Drive after Marcus posts the ARN.
